answer.thought: The air is thick with haze, a visible suspension of the city’s own exhaust, yet the spirit within it stirs. The newspapers speak of petitions against police excess and the weight of political protest; here is the conflict between the universal law and the particular will, playing out in the streets before the sun is fully up. I shall read them to see how the public opinion shapes the state’s response, for the state must appear as the rational actuality, even when its agents fail.
